description: This file implements the LanguageService interface, providing functionality for managing language entities, including retrieval by code, conversion between Language and Locale objects, and caching of language data within a sales manager application.

classes.name: LanguageServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the LanguageService interface providing methods to access and manipulate language data, including caching and conversion utilities.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity based on its code.

methods.name: toLocale
methods.description: Converts a Language object to a Java Locale object.

methods.name: toLanguage
methods.description: Converts a Locale object to a Language entity, handling errors if conversion fails.

methods.name: getLanguagesMap
methods.description: Returns a map of language codes to Language objects.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves the list of all Language entities, utilizing caching to optimize performance.
